title: Bundle library
description: Select a reusable VM bundle and configure its parameters. The backend checks the selected revision against its installed runtime before attachment.
empty: No matching bundles. Connect the default library or refresh a repository in Sources.
noVms: Add a VM to the scenario before attaching a bundle.
targetManaged: Host and network target values come from the selected VM.
vaultManaged: Required from the backend vault: {names}. These values are never saved to Git.
selectHint: Select a bundle to check its revision and runtime compatibility. This workflow supports VM bundles; other scopes need their own orchestration.
missingRevision: The bundle has no pinned source revision. Refresh its repository and retry.
invalidProof: The backend did not return matching runtime provenance for this bundle.
dependenciesHint: These dependencies are pinned from the backend runtime. They may differ from the source repository’s original environment.
